entities.name: Tomaž Planina
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tomaž Planina was a Slovenian cave photographer, speleologist, and botanist. He was most known for his work in cave photography, laboratory rope testing, especially in connection to knots, and his contribution to the development of the single-rope technique.
